de.abas.erp.api.access

Class Workspace

  • Object
    • Workspace
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    Comparable<Workspace>

    public final class Workspace
extends Object
implements Comparable<Workspace>
    The Workspace class represents workspaces as they are used in Abas ERP.

    Such workspaces are defined as 1st level subdirectories beyond the client directory of Abas. They are mainly specified by the name of that subdirectory. This name should be legal. Legal names are normalised in abas-style and consists in numerials and all letters in lower cases.

    There are certain workspaces:

    1st: The default one as path to the client directory. It is named "".

    2nd: The infosystem tools directory. It is named "is".

    Workspaces may be customer owned, which means their names start with the prefix "ow". Others are propably standard.

    Workspaces are accessible. This means that the current user can access the directory using Abas ERP.
